scope: One fixed diagnostic profile of the unchanged endpoint/P4 native parent on both original complete board fixtures. No arithmetic or instrumentation edits.

sample_design.fixtures: Both original full-resolution board fixtures in the original test. No extension or rerun based on results.

measured_gate: Only the original combined full-board assertion is executed by this diagnostic; the separate copper-neck gate is not rerun.
questions: Which native consumers account for recovered normal-form stacks on the endpoint/P4 parent?
How does recovered normal-form work divide between coefficient multiplication, other polynomial multiplication and remaining normalization?
Which Rational and allocator symbols occur under normalization and under coefficient multiplication?

source_review.finding: The retained recognizer copies closed forms into owned polynomials. Failed projections that reused certificates drop the first memo before retrying the original recognizer; each pass retains its 512-node bound. Coefficient multiplication retains the original arithmetic and insertion order. The helper series did not remove its rational arithmetic.

Exact quadratic recognition projects after shared normal-form cancellation, covering expressions with intermediate independent radicals. Exact quadratic signs then compare rational squares when signs oppose. A restricted prepass cannot replace this coverage without proof.

Comparison tries exact rationals and already-certified separated enclosures before the predicate cascade. Zero testing and sign classification consult scalar facts; unresolved comparisons retain their difference-sign fallback. This review does not establish duplicate invocation counts.

The direct sign resolver already avoids a duplicate structural-facts pass and retains exact normal forms, quadratic/radical towers and policy-authorized terminal approximation after bounded refinement. Any proposed omission must preserve certainty and escalation receipts.

related_count_evidence.limit: Invocation/materialization counts, not cycle cost or projected savings.
Equal singleton coverage does not measure nonunit eligibility, cost or predicted savings.

constraints: Freeze the runner, analysis definitions, source and sample count before execution.
